source_meta._title: Potions, tipped arrows, and dyed leather armor render with missing or incorrect colors in the inventory

stor.environment: Minecraft Java Edition snapshot 25w15a in a local single-player world, with the player in Creative mode and the Creative inventory's Search Items interface available.
preconditions: Use the exact affected snapshot 25w15a; do not use fix version 25w16a.
The Minecraft Launcher must be able to start Minecraft Java Edition 25w15a.
No particular world seed, coordinates, dimension, biome, structure, item possession, resource pack, graphics setting, or multiplayer server is specified by the report.
A newly created Creative-mode world is the simplest deterministic way to establish the required game mode.
If controls have been rebound, use the control assigned to the Inventory action instead of the default E key.

steps.action: In the Minecraft Launcher, select or create a Java Edition installation that uses the exact snapshot version 25w15a, and launch it. Do not select 25w16a because that is listed as the fix version rather than an affected version.
steps.success_cue: The Minecraft Java Edition title screen is open and identifies the running version as 25w15a.

steps.action: From the title screen, open the local-world selection menu.
steps.success_cue: The Select World screen is visible.

steps.action: Start creating a new test world. An existing world may be used instead, but creating a new one avoids unrelated inventory state.
steps.success_cue: The Create New World configuration screen is visible.

steps.action: Set the new world's game mode to Creative. If the game-mode control currently shows another mode, activate it until Creative is displayed.
steps.exact_input: Left-click the Game Mode control until it displays Creative
steps.success_cue: The world configuration screen explicitly shows Creative as the selected game mode.

steps.action: Create and enter the world. Leave the seed and other world-generation options at any values because the report does not require particular terrain.
steps.success_cue: The player has spawned into the world and the normal gameplay view and hotbar are visible.

steps.action: Wait before interacting until initial world loading has settled.
steps.success_cue: Nearby terrain is rendered, the loading overlay is gone, and player input responds normally.

steps.action: Open the player inventory. Because the player is in Creative mode, this opens the Creative inventory rather than the Survival inventory interface.
steps.success_cue: The Creative inventory interface is open and its category tabs and item grid are visible.

steps.action: Select the Creative inventory tab labeled Search Items. If tab labels are hidden, move the pointer over the tabs until the Search Items tooltip identifies the correct one, then select it.
steps.success_cue: The Search Items tab is selected and a text search field is visible above the item grid.

steps.action: Focus the search field and remove any text that may already be present so the query will contain only the report's specified word.
steps.exact_input: Left-click the search field, press Ctrl+A, then press Backspace
steps.success_cue: The insertion cursor is active in an empty Creative inventory search field.

steps.action: Enter the report's exact search term in lowercase. No Enter key is needed; allow the item grid to refresh after the final character is typed. Do not close the inventory or take an item before handing off.
steps.success_cue: The search field contains exactly “potion”, the Creative inventory remains open, and the filtered item grid has finished populating.

stor.handoff_condition: The player is in Creative mode in Minecraft Java Edition 25w15a, the Creative inventory is open on the Search Items tab, and the exact query “potion” has just populated the filtered item grid. Hand control to the observation subsystem before changing the query, selecting an item, reloading resources, or closing the inventory.
uncertainties: The formal Steps to Reproduce directly exercise potion icons only. Although the title and comments also identify tipped arrows and dyed leather armor, the report does not provide separate acquisition, dyeing, or inventory procedures for those item classes, so they are not added as unsupported mandatory steps.

Comments mention resource reloading with F3+T, restarting the game, hotbar ordering, and color inheritance among item categories, but none of those actions is required by the report's formal reproduction steps and they are therefore omitted.

The report does not specify whether to use a new or existing world. A new Creative-mode single-player world is selected as the simplest practical way to establish the stated Creative-mode precondition.
